title.zh-CN: 浏览器里跑推理:能与不能
title.en-US: Inference in the Browser: What Works, What Doesn't

summary.zh-CN: WASM / WebGPU / WebNN 三条路径,int8/int4 量化,以及下载体积、内存、延迟三堵墙——今天在浏览器里跑推理,哪些顺手、哪些会疼。
summary.en-US: The three execution paths (WASM / WebGPU / WebNN), int8/int4 quantization, and the three walls of download size, memory, and latency — an honest take on what on-device inference can and can't do today.
